messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-84217 - embeddings-queue depth rising in eu-west-1. Severity: P2. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-84217
sam: Acked — I'm on it. Taking first responder.
anya: Thanks — can you share the immediate customer impact? Any 5xx or just latency?
sam: Quick snapshot: queue depth spiked to ~600, about 30% of requests queuing >3s; embedder-service v2.1 showing ~3% 5xx on large-batch jobs.
leo: I'm spinning a small dedicated fallback pool (dedicated-embed-fallback) to offload heavy batches :gear:
sam: Reproduced locally with a replay of traffic pattern. Pushing a restart to the consumer set and bumping replica count.
anya: Noted — CS reported a customer (acme-corp) saw failed batch jobs and timeouts. I'll send a short PSA: "We're investigating elevated embedding errors in eu-west-1; mitigation in progress; ETA ~20m."
maria: Preparing a routing tweak: route <1000-token requests to the lighter embedder model as a short-term fallback. Rolling to 5% traffic first.
sam: Commands I'm running to triage:
```
kubectl -n inference get deployments,rs,hpa | grep embedder
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/embedder-service --since=15m --tail=200
```
leo: Fallback pool is up and warming weights. Running smoke tests now.
sam: Smoke test results: small batches succeed, latency down to ~180-250ms on fallback. Large batches still see throttling but dropping.
anya: Customer notif sent: "We've deployed mitigations and are observing improvement. We'll follow up with timeline and root cause." CS acknowledged.
maria: Incrementing routing rollout to 25% and watching error rate. Keeping rollback plan ready.
sam: status ping (3163141792) — queue depth: 480 -> 130; 5xx rate: 3% -> 0.9%. Progressing.
leo: I'll own the timeline and follow-ups — taking over for post-incident cleanup and RCA. Marking handoff to @leo in 30m.
sam: Handing off active monitoring to leo. I'll standby in case rollback needed.
incident-bot: Note: incident acknowledged by sam; owner set to leo; current status: monitoring.
leo: Creating a minimal postmortem stub in the incidents wiki with immediate action items (autoscaler tuning, large-batch backpressure, KV cache eviction).
anya: Thanks team. I'll update the customer thread when we have final ETA.
leo: final check (3163142399) — queue depth stable ~40, 5xx <1%. Closing PD if stable for next 10m.
_meta: Generated Slack thread: PagerDuty ack, ownership, handoff and customer-impact coordination for embeddings queue spike in eu-west-1
